run_distributed_train: run distributed training with fairseq using Slurm auto-detection or manual init method
create_distributed_init_slurm: create distributed init method automatically from Slurm job node list and process ID
test_distributed_rank: test distributed rank assignment from SLURM_PROCID and SLURM_LOCALID environment variables
review_distributed_utils_init: review fairseq distributed_utils.distributed_init for setting up multi-process training
summarize_main_entry: summarize the main entry point that parses training args and launches single_process_main
